description: This file defines various CUDA implementations for sparse matrix operations in PyTorch, including sparse-dense matrix multiplication (addmm), sampled addmm, baddbmm, and triangular solve, specifically for sparse CSR matrices.

methods.name: Tensor & sparse_sampled_addmm_out_sparse_csr_cuda(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs sparse sampled addition-matrix multiplication (addmm) operation on CSR sparse matrices with output as a sparse tensor.

methods.name: Tensor sparse_sampled_addmm_sparse_csr_cuda(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha)
methods.description: Creates a new sparse CSR tensor as the result of the sampled addmm operation.

methods.name: Tensor & addmm_out_sparse_compressed_cuda(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs general sparse-dense matrix multiplication with the operation 'result' = beta * self + alpha * (mat1 @ mat2) for sparse tensors.

methods.name: Tensor & baddbmm_out_sparse_csr_cuda(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs batch baddbmm operation for sparse CSR tensors with output tensor.

methods.name: Tensor & bmm_out_sparse_csr_cuda(const Tensor & mat1,const Tensor & mat2,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Wrapper for batch baddbmm, defaulting beta and alpha to 0 and 1 respectively.

methods.name: Tensor & addmv_out_sparse_compressed_cuda(const Tensor & self,const Tensor & mat,const Tensor & vec,const Scalar & beta,const Scalar & alpha,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Performs sparse matrix-vector multiplication for sparse compressed matrices.

methods.description: Solves a triangular system with sparse CSR matrices.
